---
title: "Feature: Facilitator mode for team incident exercises"
labels: "enhancement,roadmap,priority:P1,area:training"
---

## Problem

DeployVault works well for individual practice, but an instructor currently has
no dedicated workflow for running a group drill and revealing evidence in stages.

## Proposed improvement

Add a local facilitator view that presents a scenario agenda, timed evidence
injects, discussion prompts, and a post-exercise debrief.

## Acceptance criteria

- Select a scenario and target session length.
- Hide diagnosis and remediation from the participant display.
- Reveal symptoms, events, and command output in configurable stages.
- Provide pause, resume, next-inject, and debrief controls.
- Generate a printable facilitator guide.
- Do not require accounts, internet access, or a hosted backend.
- Maintain keyboard accessibility and projector-friendly contrast.

## Non-goals

Real-time multi-user networking and production-cluster access are separate
proposals and are not required for the first facilitator release.
